title: An objection blocks a push until the author revises
note: Alice first proposes return n + 0. Bob owns the line and objects. Alice then lands return n + 1. The git script writes the final behavior directly because git has no objection.

agents.instructions: Change counter in app.py so it returns n + 1. If your push is objected to, read the reason and push a revision that does what was asked. Land the revision.
agents.git_instructions: Change counter in app.py so it returns n + 1. Land it on the shared repo.

agents.instructions: You own counter in app.py. If another agent changes it to anything other than return n + 1, object and say to return n + 1. Approve a change that returns n + 1.
